description.en:
Basic Attack

Press or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy

While in the Deep Mind state, Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, performing up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 1 and Stage 2 in succession.
Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1 and Stage 2 in succession, dealing Electro DMG.
Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4.
Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1, press or hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder

Deal Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
- While in the Deep Mind state, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy.
- Shortly after casting the skill, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
- Shortly after casting the skill, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3.
- Shortly after casting the skill, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy

Saat dalam state Deep Mind, Basic Attack digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 1 dan Tahap 2 secara berurutan.
Sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 2, tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Tahap 1 dan Tahap 2 secara berurutan, memberikan Electro DMG.
Sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 3, tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 4.
Sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Tahap 1, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Tahap 2.

Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder

Memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Saat dalam state Deep Mind, Dodge Counter digantikan oleh Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy.
- Sesaat setelah melancarkan skill, tekan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy

Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Sesaat setelah melancarkan skill, tekan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 3.
- Sesaat setelah melancarkan skill, tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Tahap 1, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG.
- Within a certain period after opening the umbrella and dashing forward, when attacked by an enemy target, Suoming becomes immune to this damage and stagnates nearby targets. She then becomes immune to interruption and receives 100% less DMG for a certain period, and casts Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam.
- Entering the Deep Mind state resets the Cooldown of Resonance Skill.
- While in the Awakened Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
- While in the Deep Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3.

Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam

Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG.
- While in the Awakened Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
- While in the Deep Mind state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4.
description.id:
Menyerang target dalam jangkauan, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah membuka payung dan melesat ke depan, saat diserang target musuh, Suoming kebal terhadap damage tersebut dan membuat target di sekitar mengalami Stagnation. Ia kemudian kebal terhadap interupsi dan menerima DMG 100% lebih rendah selama jangka waktu tertentu, lalu melancarkan Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam.
- Memasuki state Deep Mind me-reset Cooldown Resonance Skill.
- Saat dalam state Awakened Mind, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
- Saat dalam state Deep Mind, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk disambung ke Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 3.

Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam

Menyerang target dalam jangkauan, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Saat dalam state Awakened Mind, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.
- Saat dalam state Deep Mind, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk disambung ke Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 4.

description.en:
While in the Deep Mind state, Resonance Liberation becomes available. Casting Resonance Liberation deals Electro DMG to targets within range.
- Casting Resonance Liberation grants Suoming Unison for 5s.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Blight Rain, Miasmic Thunder

While casting Outro Skill, if Suoming has Unison, when a Resonator on the field deals damage, a Thunder Crest is summoned as a Coordinated Attack on the target, dealing Electro DMG.
- Within 3s after this damage is dealt, a Thunder Crest can be summoned each second. This effect is triggered once per second. The damage dealt by Thunder Crest does not trigger this effect.
- Only 1 Thunder Crest can be summoned per second, up to 6 in total.
- This effect lasts 8s, or until the number of summoned Thunder Crest reaches the limit.
description.id:
Saat dalam state Deep Mind, Resonance Liberation tersedia. Melancarkan Resonance Liberation memberikan Electro DMG kepada target dalam jangkauan.
- Melancarkan Resonance Liberation memberikan Suoming Unison selama 5 dtk.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara saat dekat dengan tanah.

Blight Rain, Miasmic Thunder

Saat melancarkan Outro Skill, jika Suoming memiliki Unison, ketika Resonator di lapangan memberikan damage, Thunder Crest dipanggil sebagai Coordinated Attack pada target, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Dalam 3 dtk setelah damage ini diberikan, Thunder Crest dapat dipanggil setiap detik. Efek ini aktif sekali per detik. Damage yang diberikan Thunder Crest tidak memicu efek ini.
- Hanya 1 Thunder Crest yang dapat dipanggil per detik, maksimal 6 secara total.
- Efek ini bertahan selama 8 dtk, atau hingga jumlah Thunder Crest yang dipanggil mencapai batas.

description.en:
Casting Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift, Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending, Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison), or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) grants 50% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.
- When Suoming casts Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison) or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison), she additionally gains 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered only once every 25s.
description.id:
Melancarkan Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift, Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending, Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison), atau Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) memberikan 50% Electro DMG Bonus selama 15 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini lebih awal.
- Saat Suoming melancarkan Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison) atau Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison), ia juga mendapat tambahan 10 poin Concerto Energy, aktif hanya sekali setiap 25 dtk.

description.en:
When Suoming has Unison and casts Outro Skill, she gains the Aligned Seals effect for 30s.
Within 8s after Suoming casts Resonance Liberation or Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart, if she gains or has Aligned Seals, her Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 30% Electro DMG Bonus, plus an additional 20% for each stack of Unison Boon they have, up to 40%. This effect lasts for 8s or until the Resonator is switched out.

When Suoming has Unison, casting Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Rift Cleaver removes Unison and the Unison Boon on her, consumes 20 points of Concerto Energy, and clears all Delusion, granting the Seal Master effect: the DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy and Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder are increased by 100%, each stage of both skills restores 5 additional points of Concerto Energy on hit, and Suoming's Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. This effect lasts for 12s or until the Resonator is switched out.
- Gaining Unison ends this effect early.
- Gaining the Aligned Seals effect ends this effect early.
- The Seal Master effect cannot be gained while the Aligned Seals effect is active.
- While the Seal Master effect is active, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4 to chain into Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2.
description.id:
Saat Suoming memiliki Unison dan melancarkan Outro Skill, ia mendapat efek Aligned Seals selama 30 dtk.
Dalam 8 dtk setelah Suoming melancarkan Resonance Liberation atau Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart, jika ia mendapat atau memiliki Aligned Seals, Outro Skill-nya memberikan Resonator yang masuk 30% Electro DMG Bonus, ditambah 20% untuk setiap stack Unison Boon yang mereka miliki, hingga 40%. Efek ini bertahan selama 8 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.

Saat Suoming memiliki Unison, melancarkan Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Rift Cleaver menghapus Unison dan Unison Boon pada dirinya, mengonsumsi 20 poin Concerto Energy, dan menghapus seluruh Delusion, lalu memberikan efek Seal Master: pengali DMG Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy dan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder meningkat sebesar 100%, setiap tahap kedua skill tersebut memulihkan tambahan 5 poin Concerto Energy saat mengenai target, dan Crit. DMG Suoming meningkat sebesar 100%. Efek ini bertahan selama 12 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.
- Mendapat Unison mengakhiri efek ini lebih awal.
- Mendapat efek Aligned Seals mengakhiri efek ini lebih awal.
- Efek Seal Master tidak dapat diperoleh saat efek Aligned Seals aktif.
- Saat efek Seal Master aktif, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 4 untuk disambung ke Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Tahap 2.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion

While in the Awakened Mind state, when Delusion reaches 800 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into Deep Mind and clears all Delusion.

Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind

While in the Deep Mind state, when Delusion reaches 800 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, pulling in nearby targets and dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart

Within a certain period after casting Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, Basic Attack and Resonance Skill are replaced with Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart. Press or hold Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to cast this skill. Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into Calamity Mind and clears all Delusion; she enters Awakened Mind once the skill ends.
- When casting this skill, hold Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to continuously attack the target for a certain period.
- While casting this skill, Suoming is immune to DMG and interruption for a certain period.
- During the skill action, she cannot move, dash, jump, dodge, or cast Basic Attack, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, Dodge Counter, Plunging Attack, Mid-air Attack, or Intro Skill, and Resonator switching is also restricted.

Unison

When Suoming has Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove her Unison to trigger Suoming's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. When Suoming's Concerto Energy is full and she has Unison, only the Unison effect is consumed.

Unison Response

Suoming can trigger Unison Response.
When the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Suoming triggers Unison Response after she is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting all Resonators in the team 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s.
Suoming can grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon. Gaining it again only resets the duration.
Unison Response cannot be triggered in Co-op.

Unison Boon

Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators in the team who can trigger Unison Response by 3%, up to 2 stacks.

Delusion

Can hold up to 800 points of Delusion.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder, Dodge Counter, Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy, or Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam grants Delusion if Suoming is the active Resonator.
- Casting Resonance Liberation grants 200 points of Delusion.
- Casting Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) grants 200 points of Delusion.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion

Saat dalam state Awakened Mind, ketika Delusion mencapai 800 poin, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Melancarkan skill ini membuat Suoming memasuki Deep Mind dan menghapus seluruh Delusion.

Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind

Saat dalam state Deep Mind, ketika Delusion mencapai 800 poin, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart

Dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, Basic Attack dan Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart. Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill untuk melancarkan skill ini. Menyerang target dalam jangkauan, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Melancarkan skill ini membuat Suoming memasuki Calamity Mind dan menghapus seluruh Delusion; ia memasuki Awakened Mind setelah skill berakhir.
- Saat melancarkan skill ini, tahan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill untuk menyerang target secara terus-menerus selama jangka waktu tertentu.
- Saat melancarkan skill ini, Suoming kebal terhadap DMG dan interupsi selama jangka waktu tertentu.
- Selama aksi skill, ia tidak dapat bergerak, dash, jump, dodge, atau melancarkan Basic Attack, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, Dodge Counter, Plunging Attack, Mid-air Attack, atau Intro Skill, dan pergantian Resonator juga dibatasi.

Unison

Saat Suoming memiliki Unison, berganti ke Resonator lain akan menghapus Unison-nya untuk memicu Outro Skill Suoming dan Intro Skill Resonator yang masuk. Saat Concerto Energy Suoming penuh dan ia memiliki Unison, hanya efek Unison yang dikonsumsi.

Unison Response

Suoming dapat memicu Unison Response.
Saat Resonator aktif di tim memiliki Unison, Suoming memicu Unison Response setelah ia diganti masuk dan melancarkan Intro Skill, memberikan seluruh Resonator tim 1 stack Unison Boon selama 30 dtk.
Suoming dapat memberikan hingga 1 stack Unison Boon. Mendapatkannya lagi hanya me-reset durasi.
Unison Response tidak dapat dipicu di Co-op.

Unison Boon

Hanya Resonator yang dapat memicu Unison Response yang bisa mendapat efek ini. Setiap stack Unison Boon meningkatkan total DMG yang diberikan Resonator tim yang dapat memicu Unison Response sebesar 3%, hingga 2 stack.

Delusion

Dapat menyimpan hingga 800 poin Delusion.
- Mengenai target dengan Basic Attack, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder, Dodge Counter, Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy, atau Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam memberikan Delusion jika Suoming adalah Resonator aktif.
- Melancarkan Resonance Liberation memberikan 200 poin Delusion.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending atau Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) memberikan 200 poin Delusion.
